title: FUTA Express, VET strengthen Vietnam-Cambodia cargo connectivity
summary:
FUTA Express and VET have signed an MoU to expand Vietnam-Cambodia logistics, covering two-way cargo flows and operating integration.  
The cooperation will connect warehouses, vehicles, delivery points and processes, with more technology for tracking and cargo control. 
Fresh, seasonal and temperature-controlled goods are a focus, with partners aiming to cut delivery times and costs.

title: China machinery value added rises 6.4% in H1
summary:
China's major machinery enterprises posted 6.4 per cent growth in value added in H1 2026, ahead of broader industry and manufacturing.
Revenue rose 6.5 per cent to 16.1 trillion yuan (~$2.38 trillion), with output growth in 80 of 127 monitored products.
Smart equipment, industrial robots and high-end machine tools point to firmer automation demand.

title: US' textile & apparel imports slip 7% in H1 2026
summary:
US textile and apparel imports fell 7.12 per cent to $47.670 billion in January-June 2026 from $51.326 billion a year earlier.
Vietnam stayed the top supplier with 18.62 per cent share, ahead of China at 14.80 per cent.
Apparel imports declined 7.71 per cent to $35.087 billion, while non-apparel imports fell 5.43 per cent to $12.583 billion.

title: Fitch expects Canada's economy to recover after weak Q1
summary:
Fitch Ratings expects Canada's economy to recover after a weak start to 2026, supported by improving jobs, wages and resilient consumer spending. 
However, it warns trade uncertainty, Section 338 tariffs, elevated fuel costs and high household debt will keep pressure on retail, apparel and sourcing demand. 
Credit card and auto loan performance is expected to remain strained.

title: Germany's industrial production rises 0.2% in June 2026
summary:
Germany’s industrial output rose 0.2 per cent in June from May but was 0.1 per cent below June 2025, Destatis said.
Consumer goods rose 1.0 per cent, while intermediate goods fell 0.9 per cent and industry excluding energy and construction was flat.
Energy-intensive branches fell 1.8 per cent month on month, signalling uneven input-sector conditions despite higher three-month and annual output.

title: India seeks policy boost to improve textiles industry competitiveness
summary:
India’s parliamentary commerce committee has urged stronger support for textile and apparel exporters facing US tariff uncertainty. 
It recommended faster implementation of PM MITRA, PLI and Samarth schemes, specialised MMF clusters, stronger RoDTEP and RoSCTL support, concessional export finance and US warehousing hubs. 
It also called for greater focus on sustainable textiles, carpets and handlooms.

title: EU-ABC urges Malaysian policymakers to conclude FTA with bloc in 2027
summary:

title: Egypt's garment exports surge as Turkiye's apparel industry falters

Chinese and Turkish manufacturers are opening facilities in Egypt, drawn by labour costs and preferential trade access.

summary:
